application-block-page.title: Application blocked
application-block-page.headline: This application is blocked
application-block-page.gloss: Company policy restricts this application on the network.
application-block-page.extra: If you need this application for your work, send the report above and IT will review it.

credential-block-page.title: Credential submission blocked
credential-block-page.headline: Credential submission blocked
credential-block-page.gloss: You just tried to send your work username and password to a site we do not recognise as trusted.
credential-block-page.extra: {{COMPANY}} will never ask for your password on a page like this one. If a site asks you to sign in and something feels off, close the tab and go to the service directly from your bookmarks.

report.subject: Possible phishing page - credential submission blocked

credential-coach-text.title: Are you sure this is a company sign-in page?
credential-coach-text.headline: Are you sure this is a company sign-in page?
credential-coach-text.gloss: You are about to send your work username and password to a site we do not recognise as one of ours.
credential-coach-text.extra: Check the address above carefully — look for small misspellings of a name you know. Continuing sends your credentials and is recorded against your name.

report.subject: Possible phishing page - credential prompt
report.intro: I was warned before submitting credentials.

data-filter-block-page.title: Data transfer blocked
data-filter-block-page.headline: Data transfer blocked
data-filter-block-page.gloss: Company policy restricts transferring this content, so the transfer was stopped.
data-filter-block-page.extra: If you need to send this for your work, send the report above and IT will review it.

report.subject: Blocked data transfer
report.intro: A data transfer was blocked by policy.
report.prompt: Why I need to send this:

file-block-continue-page.title: Continue with this download?
file-block-continue-page.headline: Continue with this download?
file-block-continue-page.gloss: Downloading files of this type is restricted by company policy. You can continue if you need this file for your work.
file-block-continue-page.extra: Only continue if you know what this file is and where it came from.

report.subject: File download warning
report.intro: I was warned before downloading a restricted file type.

file-block-page.title: This file type is blocked
file-block-page.headline: This file type is blocked
file-block-page.gloss: Transferring files of this type is restricted by company policy, so the transfer was stopped.
file-block-page.extra: If you need this file for your work, send the report above and IT will review it.

report.subject: Blocked file transfer
report.intro: A file transfer was blocked by policy.
